# Comfy Clarity AI- Crystal Video Upscaler

Upscale a video with Clarity AI's Crystal model, running through the Fal proxy: one video in, one upscaled video out. Set scale_factor to multiply the frame size, and the output keeps the source resolution, frame count and audio track. The result is capped at 9 megapixels per frame and 360 megapixel-seconds per clip, so long or oversized clips come back upscaled by less than the factor you asked for. Ideal for restoring generated clips, preparing footage for large screens, and sharpening soft AI video. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_clarity_ai_crystal_video_upscale.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
